units: SI; explicit degrees only where named

coordinates.board_frame: z up; x is slice normal from exposed end into remainder; y is drawing direction
coordinates.knife: cutting edge and blade faces must be identified from existing geometry
coordinates.cut_plane: initial end slice at x_end + target thickness; no shared mechanical nodes across planned interface

geometry.shape: rounded ellipsoid with mild adjustable asymmetry

mesh_spacing_m.note: must resolve 10 mm slice and narrow blade contact without excessive particle penetration

interface_spacing_m.note: convergence tests required; avoid zero-length ordinary springs

collision_particle_radius_m.note: must not bridge released cut or permit blade tunneling

representations.visual: smooth surface with separate cut faces; appearance detail independent of mechanics
representations.collision: simplified exterior and per-piece cut surfaces; no hull across both released pieces
representations.mechanical: coarse volume-supporting spring network, with finite-length damageable interface bonds; FEM alternative uses separate node sets and cohesive coupling

mass_kg.note: measure samples; do not set mass and density inconsistently

density_kg_m3.note: derive from mass and measured/model volume

flesh_elastic_modulus_pa.note: FEM/reference continuum parameter; reduced-network mapping must be documented

poisson_ratio.note: compressibility assumption; nearly incompressible locking must be checked

bulk_or_volume_penalty_pa.note: only if chosen reduced model needs explicit volume constraint

network_stiffness_n_m.note: discretization-dependent; not interchangeable with Young modulus

network_damping_n_s_m.note: discretization-dependent, keep dissipation distinct from fracture

skin_peak_traction_pa.note: effective skin law; no explicit thin skin required initially

flesh_peak_traction_pa.note: cohesive initiation; distinct from compressive contact

skin_fracture_energy_j_m2.note: integrate damage dissipation per interface area

knife_friction.note: measure/identify; no arbitrary value treated as real

fixture_stiffness.note: record axes, force reactions and which remainder nodes constrained

damage_contract.state: D in [0,1] per finite interface patch; monotonic within episode
damage_contract.initiation: local verified blade interaction plus traction/work law; neither time nor depth alone
damage_contract.evolution: law to be selected and energy-accounted; threshold values remain null
damage_contract.broken_bond: remove all intended tensile/shear cohesive stiffness AND damping; retain appropriate compressive contact without healing
damage_contract.mesh_scaling: patch area weights traction/fracture energy; no duplicated force/energy budget with refinement
damage_contract.topology: pre-separated index sets, no undeclared tet/spring/skin/constraint still spanning released interface
damage_contract.reset: restore all bond/material/contact/fixture states and log model hash

validation_required: available wrist trace vs blade trajectory
execution_gate: Null physical/numerical parameters are missing inputs, not zero or permission to pick undocumented defaults.
